quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 1,834,703,474.39, up 17.14%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 338,572,473.12, up 68.12%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 340,589,197.19, up 95.30%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 348,814,103.58, Q2 RMB 399,238,472.67, Q3 RMB 550,218,921.11, Q4 RMB 536,431,977.03; quarterly net profit: Q1 RMB 61,727,912.71, Q2 RMB 59,743,205.56, Q3 RMB 130,228,368.33, Q4 RMB 86,872,986.52. The company attributes the growth to steady consumer-electronics demand plus new-product launches at its North American major customer and large-scale delivery of new projects; faster growth in optical-module VC thermal modules, server thermal parts and high-performance thermal materials; and product-mix optimization and cost reduction.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report, FY2025): R&D spend RMB 101,773,142.12, 5.55% of revenue; 195 R&D staff; 282 patent applications to date (135 invention, 147 utility model). The company launched a self-developed graphene thermal pad for AI chips, is pursuing a next-generation graphene pad on a new technical route, and is pushing ultra-thin VC, 3D VC, integrated VC modules and microchannel structural parts toward industrialization; its liquid-cooling system integration R&D project (optimizing cold-plate microchannel processes) covers customer-specific design, customer validation and batch production.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Liquid-cooling acquisition (annual report): the company's wholly owned Yixing subsidiary acquired 51% of Zhongshi Xunleng Thermal Technology (Dongguan) through a capital increase, consolidated from December 2025, to fill out its liquid-cooling capability; the company says liquid-cooling products quickly reached batch delivery after the deal, and thermal-module core parts, TIM and liquid-cooling modules are in batch supply to server and data-center customers. For AI servers it offers a 'high-performance thermal material + liquid cold plate' package.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (annual report): the Thailand base completed its phase-1 capacity expansion and passed factory audits by core customers including the North American major customer, Samsung and Nokia, with multiple products in batch delivery; the Thailand subsidiary had 2025 revenue RMB 279,424,145.16 and net profit RMB 90,255,461.81. The Thailand plant EPC contract (signed September 18, 2025, RMB 21,400.00 ten-thousand) was 25.28% complete at year-end. Domestically the Yixing base kept adding capacity on fast-growing orders, with VC, heat pipe and liquid-cooling module products in scaled delivery across consumer electronics, optical communication, servers and medical equipment.
quarterly_data.figure: Thailand subsidiary 2025 net profit RMB 90,255,461.81; EPC 25.28% complete

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (annual report): the company says it will focus on consumer electronics, digital infrastructure, clean energy and automotive electronics, follow the 'AI+' trend with core materials, components and modules, and shift from a single-major-customer strategy to major customers plus industry-wide solutions, driven by both industrial operation and capital operation; it is tracking new products in AI terminals, AI data centers, smart medical devices and robots.

players.product: VC (vapor chamber) thermal modules, thermal interface materials and liquid-cooling modules for 800G / 1.6T optical modules (connector liquid cold plates, NPO liquid cooling)

quarterly_data.quarter: Jones Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical communication (annual report, FY2025): as optical modules move to 800G and 1.6T, the company launched a VC thermal-module solution for optical modules ('functional materials + VC thermal module'); its VC module products have passed certification at leading domestic and overseas optical-communication makers and are in supply, and it is speeding up integrated VC module solutions while doing pre-research for 3.2T optical modules and CPO / NPO, where liquid cooling and other new thermal solutions are emerging.

Jones Tech.why: Thermal-management maker whose optical-module VC thermal modules, server thermal parts, high-performance TIM and liquid-cooling modules (microchannel cold plates in volume use in data-center AI servers) grow with AI server and 800G / 1.6T optical-module build-out.
Jones Tech.evidence: Jones Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026): VC thermal module delivery for optical modules kept growing and its supplier position at core customers was consolidated; it entered a leading connector customer's supplier system with some thermal products in volume delivery and is developing connector liquid cold plates and NPO liquid cooling for 1.6T optical modules. Jones Tech investor Q&A (09-11-2026): some microchannel liquid-cooling products are in volume application in data-center AI servers.
